verdict.rationale: ReadMe ships an official CLI (rdme) and a documented REST API for controlling docs programmatically, both of which support headless/CI automation (e.g., syncing OpenAPI specs in pipelines). However, the evidence pack lacks explicit CI/CD workflow examples, headless-mode documentation, or community confirmation of CI usage. Missing for 10: explicit CI pipeline examples/docs, headless-mode guarantees, and independent confirmation of automated CLI/API use in production pipelines.
